blocks.text:
This calendar is a folder of files. calendar.json sets the title, the dates and the time the doors open. Each day has its own folder, days/01 to days/25, with a day.json that lists what its door holds.

Door N opens on day N at the unlock time, in the calendar's time zone. Until then the server refuses it, so the page source reveals nothing early.

The next doors show each kind of block, one at a time. A text block like this one makes a small door, and a text longer than its door fades out at the bottom.
